description: This file defines a React component SidebarNavigation for rendering a sidebar menu with navigation items, including logic for active state determination and responsive behavior.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes URL paths by removing trailing slashes, defaulting null/undefined to root ('/').

methods.name: startsWithPathSegment
methods.description: Checks if the current path starts with a given base segment.

methods.name: isNavItemActive
methods.description: Determines if a navigation item should be marked as active based on the current route.
